newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo U.S. Treasury market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo U.S. Treasury market closed for holiday.

text.p: U.S. Treasury market was closed in Tokyo on Friday for the Easter holiday in the United States.
Traders said the Tokyo market will resume trading on Monday.
Treasury prices closed sharply lower in New York overnight on the results of home sales report and technical selling.
The bellwether 30-year bond ended off 1-9/32 at 94-8/32. Its yield jumped to 7.09 percent, its highest closing level since September 11, 1996 when it climbed to 7.11 percent.
